name: lanceauto
description: LanceAuto: casa de leilões de carros

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w packages/shared" "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w packages/shared -w apps/api -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/shared -w apps/api -w apps/web
